_readme: What every cue in the template is SHAPED like. What it is PLAYED on is a SoundStyle
under data/sounds - three of those share this one bank, the same way three sprite
styles share the one gb16 rig.
Every key is optional and every cue states only what it cares about:
hz/hz_end  pitch at the start and end; equal means no sweep
steps      hold the sweep on N rungs instead of gliding - an arpeggio, not a siren
attack_ms  fade-in, which is what stops a click at the start
gain       cue level before the style's gain and the player's volume
Gains are NOT uniform on purpose. A footstep and a talk blip fire constantly and sit
low; a level-up fires twice a game and is allowed to be loud. The rule of thumb is
that the quieter a cue is, the more often the player will hear it.
